messages:
ricardo: Looping everyone in for Hightower Bank POC. Core asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (users + groups), fine-grained RBAC, domain locking to their corp domains, and proof we can meet audit/log retention. They also asked about encrypted assertions and EU data residency. Can we confirm what works on Hosted vs Dedicated and an ETA for a demo?

leah: Short answer: Hosted supports SAML (signed assertions) + SCIM v2 over TLS and standard role mapping via groups. Encrypted SAML assertions require tenant-specific key material which we only provide for Dedicated or Private. EU data residency = Dedicated in eu-west.

nate: Pricing note: Hosted enterprise tier + support covers most customers; Dedicated is quoted as a fixed monthly capacity + onboarding fee. Ballpark: assume ~1.8x cost for Dedicated for a small pool. If they need guaranteed in-region hardware and assertion encryption, it'll be Dedicated.

emily: On audit/logs they specifically want 12 months retention + export for eDiscovery. We can provide longer retention as an add-on for Hosted, but Dedicated/Private gives them more control and a straight SLA. For the POC we can demo 90d retention and show the export pipeline.

ricardo: SAML details they required: SP-initiated + IdP-initiated, signed AuthnRequests, encrypted assertions preferred, NameID format email, and want attribute mapping for roles (claim: groups -> app_role). Also they want an allowed domain list at tenant level so only @hightower.com addresses can create accounts.

leah: We can do SP + IdP initiated. Signed AuthnRequests: yes. Encrypted assertions: Dedicated only. Domain locking: we use a DNS TXT verification flow (we issue token -> customer adds TXT -> system verifies -> tenant bound). If their security team won't touch DNS, we can support an alternate verification by email to a security alias, but they prefer DNS.

nate: For SCIM please ask Hightower to provide a test admin client (token or client creds) and a sample of their user JSON. Common gotchas: nested groups and custom attributes (they may use `employeeType` or `custom:role`). We can accept a custom SCIM extension `urn:com:redwood:role` if they want direct role assignment. That requires a quick mapping rule on our side.

emily: Quick SCIM example (we'll send this to them):
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"j.lee@hightower.com","name":{"givenName":"Jin","familyName":"Lee"},"emails":[{"value":"j.lee@hightower.com","primary":true}],"groups":[{"value":"ops","display":"Operations"}],"urn:com:redwood:role":"app.reader"}
```

ricardo: Good. On RBAC mapping: they'd like a sample mapping file that ties SCIM groups -> Redwood roles and also an example for attribute-based role rules (e.g., if `department=fraud` then assign `fraud-analyst`). Nate, can you draft both?

nate: Will do. Draft mapping will look like: `BR_Ops -> org.admin`, `BR_Engineers -> app.editor`, plus a rule to map `department=fraud` to `app.fraud`. I'll post a concrete JSON shortly.

infra-bot: Automated: staging-saml-connector created (id: smc-2145). Metadata URL: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata/smc-2145

leah: Blockers we should flag back to Hightower: 1) If they require assertion encryption on Hosted — we can't meet that without Dedicated. 2) EU residency requirement — Hosted US-only by default; need Dedicated EU region. 3) Nested group handling — callout in mapping. 4) Any custom SCIM extensions must be agreed and scheduled.

ricardo: Timeline ask: they want a demo next Tue and a POC within 3 weeks. Realistic?

nate: If they hand over test IdP creds, SCIM admin token, and confirm domain contact by EOD Friday, we can do a partial demo (SAML login flow + SCIM sync) next Tue. Full RBAC + domain-lock demo in 3 weeks assuming a brief mapping tweak session.

emily: Legal/GRC wants a DPIA and DPA addendum when we go Dedicated; I'll prepare the template and note the EU hosting options. For Hosted demo we can provide the standard data processing terms.

ricardo: Action items: ricardo -> request IdP metadata + SCIM test creds + domain contact from Hightower; nate -> prepare mapping JSON + test scripts; leah -> prepare SAML/Dedicated constraints doc and sample DNS TXT text; emily -> prep DPIA/DPA template.

nate: Also pro tip for the demo: enable verbose SAML logs in staging so we can capture signature/clock-skew issues. Use `?debug=true` on ACS callback to see raw assertions.

ricardo: OK I'll ping the customer now and loop back here once they reply. Thanks all :thumbsup:
